body.name: \((I_{\pi}:\pi\in\Pi_m)\)
body.construction: If \(N<b_{\beta,D}\log(40m)\), set \(I_{\pi}=G_{\tau}\) for every \(\pi\in\Pi_m\). Otherwise use \(T^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m}=\{N/\log(40m)\}^{1/(2\beta+4)}\). At \(z=T^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m},eT^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m}\), set \(J_{xa}(z)=[0,1]\cap 2m\operatorname{CP}_{\gamma_0/(4m)}\{K_{xa}(z);n\}\) when this intersection is nonempty, and set \(J_{xa}(z)=\{0\}\) otherwise. Let the raw region be the intersection of \([1,4]\times[-\log2,0]\) with the two induced Hall strips displayed in the symbol definition of \(\Theta_{xa}\). If this raw region is nonempty, set \(\Theta_{xa}\) equal to it; if it is empty, set \(\Theta_{xa}:=\{(1,-\log2)\}\). For every \(\pi\in\Pi_m\), minimize and maximize the unique root of \(m^{-1}\sum_x\exp(\widetilde v_x-\widetilde\alpha_xt)=\tau\) over \((\widetilde\alpha_x,\widetilde v_x)\in\Theta_{x,\pi(x)}\), obtaining \(\underline t_{\pi}\) and \(\overline t_{\pi}\), and put \(J^*_{\pi}:=[\underline t_{\pi}-\varepsilon_{\tau},\overline t_{\pi}+\varepsilon_{\tau}]\). If \(J^*_{\pi}\cap G_{\tau}\neq\varnothing\), set \(I_{\pi}:=J^*_{\pi}\cap G_{\tau}\). If the intersection is empty, set \(I_{\pi}\) equal to the singleton containing the metric projection of the midpoint of \(J^*_{\pi}\) onto \(G_{\tau}\). All set comparisons and lexicographic tie resolutions are exact; Clopper--Pearson endpoints and the scalar roots may equivalently be computed to arbitrary prescribed accuracy by monotone bisection, and the finite policy class may be enumerated.
